platforms.name: Web
platforms.detailedDescription: A telemedicine and medical appointment platform connecting patients, doctors, and secretaries. My role in this project was to step into an ongoing codebase within a larger team environment (web, mobile, and backend squads). I was responsible for surgically integrating existing React screens (built with Material UI) with the backend RESTful APIs. I worked directly on connecting forms, scheduling lists, and mapping patient data, navigating a legacy ecosystem that mixed Redux-Saga and the Context API.
learnings: Ability to quickly adapt to extensive, existing codebases, managing established architectural patterns and technical debt.
Collaborative teamwork and synchronization of deliverables in a multi-developer environment.
Resolving complex UI bugs and integrating asynchronous flows for medical scheduling and payments.
